name: Eventdex
description_en:
Eventdex supports in-person, hybrid and virtual event operations, spanning registration, check-in, badges, mobile experiences, matchmaking and exhibitor lead collection. The organizer, attendee and exhibitor workflows have different responsibilities; recording a visitor’s attendance is not the same as giving an exhibitor access to that person’s lead details.

The platform can be purchased as selected modules or a broader package. A free floor-plan entry point exists, but the full event software uses a custom quote based on attendees, events and products. This profile follows registration-to-onsite operations rather than treating every named module as an included entitlement.
description_zh:
Eventdex 支持线下、线上和混合活动，覆盖报名、签到、徽章、移动体验、配对和展商线索。主办方、参与者及展商职责不同，记录某人到场不等于允许展商访问其线索信息。

可以选择模块或较广组合。平台有免费平面图入口，但完整活动软件按人数、活动和产品定制询价。本文沿报名到现场运营说明，不把所有模块当成已包含权益。

core_features.explanation_en: Store check-ins locally and sync after connectivity returns.
core_features.explanation_zh: 本地保存签到，联网后同步。

core_features.explanation_en: Capture and qualify scanned leads under a separately scoped module.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在单独约定模块内扫描并筛选线索。

en: Check in registered expo guests and deliver qualified leads to the correct exhibitor.
zh: 为展会报名者签到，并把合格线索交给正确展商。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose modules and hardware, import a test attendee and reconcile an offline scan and lead export.
steps.zh: 选择模块及硬件，导入测试人员并核对离线扫描及线索导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Custom event/module package, attendee volume and services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Full-platform and individual-module prices are quoted by attendee volume, event count and products. A free floor-plan option is advertised separately. One-time, monthly and annual/volume options are described; no amount, free full-platform entitlement or equipment inclusion was established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 完整平台及模块按人数、活动数与产品询价，免费平面图独立列出。说明有单次、月度和年度/批量选项，未确定金额、完整平台免费权益或设备是否包含。

sources.title: Event Management Software | AI-Powered Events | Eventdex
sources.research_notes_en: Event platform includes registration, mobile app, lead retrieval, matchmaking and floor planning, with distinct organizer and exhibitor roles.

sources.title: Event Management Software Pricing | Eventdex
sources.research_notes_en: Quoted modules by event count/attendee volume; free floor plan is narrower than full-platform access.

sources.title: Event Check-In and Badge Printing Software | Eventdex
sources.research_notes_en: QR/barcode onsite operations, device-local offline check-in and later sync; printer choices require hardware planning.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Follow a registered attendee through the door
sections.title_zh: 核对报名者的入场流程
sections.en: The onsite page describes QR/barcode scanning, self-check-in and badge printing, with offline records kept on the device until reconnection. For an illustrative expo, preload a representative attendee, scan at the intended entrance and inspect event versus session attendance. Test duplicate scans and a connection outage rather than accepting a scan-speed claim as operational evidence. No onsite workflow was executed here.
sections.zh: 现场页介绍二维码/条码扫描、自助签到及徽章打印，离线记录留在设备直到联网。例如展会可预装代表性人员，在实际入口扫描，再区分活动与场次出席。应测试重复扫描和断网，不能用速度宣传代替运行证据。本文未执行现场流程。

sections.title_en: Plan the physical and data handoff
sections.en: Eventdex lists several printer families and describes CRM export and lead qualification. A working deployment still needs compatible stock, drivers, devices, network and staff permissions. The lead module includes notes and qualifiers and describes offline capture. Confirm exactly which exhibitors can export which records and how the recipient system deduplicates them; an integration name alone does not establish a correct CRM record.
sections.zh: Eventdex 列出多种打印机，并介绍 CRM 导出与线索筛选。真实部署仍需兼容耗材、驱动、设备、网络和员工权限。线索模块包括备注、筛选和离线采集，需确认每个展商可导出哪些记录、目标系统如何去重。集成名称本身不能证明 CRM 记录正确。

sections.title_en: Ask for the module and event scope in the quote
sections.title_zh: 让报价列明模块与活动范围
sections.en: Pricing describes a one-time single-event package or a monthly plan across events, with annual and volume options also mentioned. Attendee volume, event count and selected products determine the quote; no standard amount was verified. The free floor-plan offer is not evidence of free registration, badge hardware, matchmaking or lead retrieval. Confirm support hours, setup, equipment, payment-provider fees and post-event access explicitly.
sections.zh: 定价介绍单次活动包或跨活动月度方案，也提到年度及批量选项，按人数、活动数和产品询价，未核实标准金额。免费平面图不证明报名、徽章硬件、配对或线索收集免费。应明确支持时间、配置、设备、支付商费用和会后访问。

sections.title_en: Use it for connected event operations with an owner
sections.title_zh: 为有明确负责人的活动运营选型
sections.en: Eventdex merits evaluation when organizer and exhibitor operations need a connected system. A simple RSVP or static venue diagram may need a narrower setup. Check attendance reconciliation after reconnecting, lead consent, exports and an event-day escalation route. No source license, self-hosted package, contractual storage region or guaranteed recovery was verified; vendor queue-reduction and engagement claims were not independently measured.
sections.zh: 主办方与展商需要连接运营时可以评估 Eventdex，简单 RSVP 或静态平面图可能只需较窄配置。应核对联网后出席对账、线索同意、导出和活动日升级联系渠道。源码许可、自托管、合同存储地区和保证恢复未核实，排队减少与互动改善未独立测量。

research_gaps: No account, payment, badge printer, offline synchronization, matchmaking or lead export was tested.
Quote, hardware/processor charges, duplicate resolution, consent, retention/residency, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
